title: Feature request: automate 'eating soon', before getting up, using an alarm clock
symptom: The user wants to automate the 'eating soon' target to switch on 30 minutes before waking up, as their morning routine takes about 30 minutes, to have active insulin for breakfast.
fix: The thread suggests using external automation tools like IFTTT and Automate in combination with Nightscout for looping systems, or using AAPS which already has this feature built in.
evidence_quote: There are a number of ways of doing this using IFTTT and Automate in combination with Nightscout for those using looping systems.
